# YOUNGSUN PAPER

> YOUNGSUN PAPER is a paper and paperboard manufacturer and export supplier based in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. The company serves packaging, printing, converting, publishing and food-service buyers.

## Main Website Sections

- Home: https://youngsunpaper.com/
- Products: https://youngsunpaper.com/products
- Industries: https://youngsunpaper.com/industries
- Materials library: https://youngsunpaper.com/materials
- Processing services: https://youngsunpaper.com/processing
- About YOUNGSUN: https://youngsunpaper.com/about
- Paper buying guides: https://youngsunpaper.com/blog
- Frequently asked questions: https://youngsunpaper.com/faq
- Contact and quotations: https://youngsunpaper.com/contact
- Spanish website: https://youngsunpaper.com/es/

## Product Categories

- Package board: grey board, black paper, folding box board, duplex board, C2S art board, kraft paper, color card paper and PE coated paper.
- Culture paper: woodfree paper, art paper, multi-format copy paper, A4 copy paper, color offset paper, LWC paper, NCR paper, newsprint and thermal paper.
- Fancy paper: soft touch paper, leather paper, pearlescent paper, embossed paper, label paper, tracing paper, metallic card and color tissue paper.
- Food packaging paper: cup paper, greaseproof paper, silicone coated paper and MG paper.

## Commercial Information

- Minimum order quantity is product-specific. It depends on grade, GSM or thickness, size, source mill, stock availability and packing.
- YOUNGSUN covers the cost of standard product samples. The customer pays international courier charges.
- Production, loading and estimated ocean transit times are confirmed separately in each quotation.
- Certification and test documents are confirmed for the exact product grade, producing mill and destination market.
- Custom sheet sizes, reel widths, slitting, sheeting, labeling, packing and selected converting services are available according to the product and order.

## Mill Supply Network

YOUNGSUN's mill supply network includes APP, Sun Paper, Nine Dragons, Liansheng and Huatai.
